briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.5% and S&P 500 -0.2% — no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold anyway, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and skipping new buys rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept in reserve, ready to deploy when a genuinely attractive opportunity appears. Today's cash balance is below the threshold needed to safely open a new position, and the market gave no strong risk-on signal anyway — so the disciplined move is to hold that cash rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留在手的現金，待出現真正吸引的投資機會時才動用。今日現金水平未達到安全開倉的門檻，加上市場亦未見明顯的風險偏好訊號，因此紀律上應該保留現金，而非勉強進行交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst. Without a strong move in either direction, there's no clear signal to chase new positions. Days like this are common and don't require action — the market simply consolidated near recent levels.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納指下跌0.5%，標普500下跌0.2%，並無重大消息面刺激，屬於方向不明的觀望盤。由於升跌幅度有限，缺乏明確的進場訊號，這類走勢十分常見，無需特別採取行動，市場只是在近期水平附近整固。
